Keep Tool Kumar, JSON, file formats, language names, keyboard keys (Ctrl, Shift, Alt, Esc, Enter, Tab, Space) and anything that is code untranslated. UI labels must match the 'UI labels referenced in the text' table of your glossary. Keep labels short: buttons, tabs and menu items share small toolbars, also on phones.
